children: RBC Capital reiterated their Outperform rating on Brookfield Asset Mgmt's stock with a price target of $65.00.
The price target implies an upside of 43.1% from the Sep 17 close of $45.42.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Brookfield Asset Management is targeting to double its fee-bearing capital to $1.3 trillion by 2031, with significant growth expected in its credit division, which is projected to increase by approximately $360 billion at a CAGR of 16%. This ambitious growth plan positions the firm well to capitalize on market opportunities and drive future earnings.

: The company has successfully increased its client base and diversified its strategies, which enhances the durability of its earnings profile. With no single asset class representing more than one-third of its revenues, Brookfield is better insulated against market volatility, making it an attractive investment for institutional and high-net-worth clients.
